_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Teacher', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "surahs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "ayah_count" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "juz_surah_ranges" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "juz_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "surah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "from_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "age" INTEGER NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_name" TEXT NULL, "parent_phone" TEXT NULL, "current_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "last_completed_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "total_completed_juz" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "level" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'مبتدئ', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "teacher_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES students (id), "group_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "session_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'فردي', "occurrence_date" INTEGER NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_memorizations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sessions (id), "surah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "from_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_revisions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sessions (id), "surah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "from_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_evaluations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sessions (id), "memorization_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tajweed_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fluency_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "accuracy_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_attendances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "attendance_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'حاضر', "memorization_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "memorization_from_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "memorization_to_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "revision_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "revision_from_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "revision_to_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "memorization_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tajweed_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fluency_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "accuracy_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("session_id", "student_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time" TEXT NOT NULL, "memorization_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "memorization_from_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "memorization_to_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "revision_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "revision_from_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "revision_to_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'سورة', "target_surah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "target_juz_number" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'لم يبدأ', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memorized_ranges" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "surah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surahs (id), "from_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'محفوظ', "revision_cycle_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "last_revised_at" INTEGER NULL, "next_review_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_members" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "joined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("group_id", "student_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_schedule_slots" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "fixed_time" TEXT NULL, "prayer_name" TEXT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "effective_from" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_to" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_exceptions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_schedule_slot_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES group_schedule_slots (id), "occurrence_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exception_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "new_date" INTEGER NULL, "new_time" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "juz_quarter_progress" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "juz_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quarter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("student_id", "juz_number", "quarter_index"));
